goal: Stop NAT port mapping and Tor connection attempts when network activity is turned off
Ensures nodes produce no unwanted network traffic when configured to stay inactive
reviewability: Needs rebase and an author reply to an open objection
Reviewing now would duplicate feedback already awaiting an author response
agreement: Nonblocking objection: rapid toggling during backoff sleep increases reconnect delay (winterrdog)
Resolved objection: reconnect backoff was not resetting upon reactivation (bradleystachurski)
Verified by testing traffic teardown and network test suites (brunoerg, Jhackman2019)
Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, fanquake)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it eliminates unintended local network traffic when network activity is disabled
The benefit is small since it only affects nodes intentionally running with networking turned off
It restores expected behavior for users seeking complete local network quiet
